review_method: All 60 ambiguous photos inspected in original-RGB annotation QA plots; selected difficult photos also inspected individually.
exact_class_sample: 15 distinct photos covering the first two image IDs per exact class were inspected; two issues recorded. This is not exhaustive verification of other photos.

additional_sample_issues.06bdb5ea9ec0e963: Indoor artificial Christmas trees; living-tree scene domain is not established.
additional_sample_issues.00f3dbbbf5bdf2cf: Photo includes large unannotated pallet chairs beside the labeled couch; do not train them as background.

limitations: Statue candidates emphasize clear human/carved figures; broader sculpture targets remain in scope and require suitable real examples.
Some source boxes exclude pot extents or other target instances; semantic suitability alone does not authorize their use as complete YOLO labels.
Do not silently use quarantined photos as negatives or turn Sculpture/Houseplant mappings into accepted target classes.
